text: The security review flags the number check: a character that is both outside the allowed set and invisible can match two ways in one repeated group.
Old pattern, a digit then hidden characters then a letter: 20 hidden characters took 108 ms, 24 took 1084 ms, 26 took 4355 ms.
Version 0.4.0 was merged but not yet published when this was found. npm still showed 0.3.0.
The pattern is now one character class, with invisible letters marked first. A timed test holds the longest text a storyboard allows under 200 ms.
Pull request 7 passed its checks and was merged before the release command was sent.
